title: One ticket on bus then tram

turns.user: I have one ordinary BKK single ticket. I'll ride a bus for 10 minutes.
turns.agent:
Your ordinary single ticket generally covers one continuous one-way ride on an ordinary bus within the applicable area, so a 10-minute bus ride should fit that use. Validate it as required for the ticket format before starting. It does not cover the 100E airport shuttle, and a voluntary transfer to another street-level service normally needs another ticket. BKK: Single ticket

That’s based on the 5 November 2026 snapshot, not a live check. Is this an ordinary bus (not 100E), and will you stay on the same bus for the ride?

turns.user: Then I want to board a tram to finish the trip. Can I reuse that same single ticket?
turns.agent:
No. For a bus-to-tram transfer, an ordinary single ticket generally does not cover both street-level rides; you’ll need another single ticket for the tram. That’s different from a permitted transfer between metro lines in the same direction. BKK: Single ticket

This is based on the 5 November 2026 snapshot, not a live check. I can’t verify your ticket or validate it for you.
